name: Brex
description: Brex lets agents look up expenses, users, cards, banking transactions, and bills in the account of the signed-in user. Each user signs in to their own Brex account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which of my expenses this month are missing receipts?
Summarize card spend by team for last quarter.
Which bills are due in the next two weeks?

apps.name: Brex
apps.description: Expense, card, transaction, and bill lookup, over Brex's MCP server with browser sign-in.
